authorization: User: proceed, finish all necessary, pause on hardware problems such as OOM

training.selection: validation NMSE at epoch 1 and every 5 epochs; minimum improvement 1e-5; stop after 8 unimproved checks
training.preprocessing: training-only mean and one global RMS; reuse fixed whole-genus splits

matching: For each original feature, maximize signed Pearson correlation of activations across training species. Report same-pair signed decoder cosine and validation Pearson correlation. No sign flips: activations are nonnegative.
matching_reuse: Best matches can reuse new features; explicitly report collisions. SciPy unavailable; no one-to-one assignment used.

candidate_gate.validation: confirmation reported separately; no post hoc gate changes

nulls: One independent species-row permutation of each trained seed plus a fixed random unit-column dictionary; diagnostic references, not significance tests
hardware: CUDA required; snapshot before/after each run; stop on any exception/OOM, >=88 C, or <2 GiB free VRAM; no fallback/retry
limitations: Matching is anchored to the original SAE, not an all-pairs equivalence proof.
A stable feature is not necessarily a biological trait.
5,388 animal species subset is not the complete TreeOfLife-1M species set.
